Intel® Edison Board Software Downloadsから以下をダウンロードしました。

item.content:encoded:
export GOPATH=~/
#export GOROOT=${GOPATH}

function peco-src () {
local selected_dir=$(ghq list -p | peco --query "$LBUFFER")
if [ -n "$selected_dir" ]; then
BUFFER="cd ${selected_dir}"
zle accept-line
fi
zle clear-screen
}
zle -N peco-src
bindkey '^[' peco-src

src/gz all http://repo.opkg.net/edison/repo/all
src/gz core2-32 http://repo.opkg.net/edison/repo/core2-32
_EOF_

src/gz edison http://repo.opkg.net/edison/repo/edison
を削除。


tee /etc/opkg/intel-iotdk.conf << _EOF_ >/dev/null
src intel-all http://iotdk.intel.com/repos/1.1/iotdk/all
src intel-iotdk http://iotdk.intel.com/repos/1.1/intelgalactic
src intel-quark http://iotdk.intel.com/repos/1.1/iotdk/quark
src intel-i586 http://iotdk.intel.com/repos/1.1/iotdk/i586
src intel-x86 http://iotdk.intel.com/repos/1.1/iotdk/x86
_EOF_


echo "src mraa-upm http://iotdk.intel.com/repos/1.1/intelgalactic" > /etc/opkg/mraa-upm.conf
opkg update
opkg install
opkg install libmraa0

opkg update && opkg upgrade

opkg install bash && opkg install less && opkg install git

opkg install bash
opkg install less
opkg install git

chsh -s /bin/bash

vi /lib/systemd/system/sshd.socket

add # to BindToDevice=usb0 with a #

opkg install libmraa0

ifconfig usb0 down && ifconfig wlan0 down && ifconfig wlan0 up

item.content:encoded:
Inten Edison R2ファームウェアで解決済みなissueは以下です。

  • EDISON-1801
    • Wi-Fi latency is higher than expected.
